cross_project_dependencies.description: Storage benchmark exists to select Andi Car's permanent storage architecture. Benchmark methodology, candidates and evaluation all serve the Car project.
Lab MK1 was built partly to execute benchmark manufacturing and testing. Lab provides execution infrastructure for benchmark work.
Lab is external support infrastructure for Car development. Intended to eventually be replaced by Car-native capability.
IGEL is the physical prototype chassis for Andi Car. Hardware reconnaissance, installation and proven infrastructure live on this machine.
Preservation exists to make Car history navigable. Sits outside Car authority. Car should contain only a discoverable pointer to preservation.
Operating Standard and Working Profile govern all projects including Car. They are universal, not Car-specific.
Operating Standard governs Lab operations. Lab has additional local governance (Operator Record, Control Contract) but global rules apply.
